title: 51. Longest Repeating Character Replacement

examples.explanation: Replace the two 'B's with 'A' (or the two 'A's with 'B') to get "AAAA" ("BBBB"), a substring of 4 identical characters.
Replace the 'B' at index 3 with 'A' to get "AAAABBA", giving a "AAAA" substring of length 4. Alternatively, replace the 'A' at index 4 with 'B' to get "AABBBBA", giving a "BBBB" substring.
